basis: Ascend to each recorded floor and visit its bag corridor; finish at highest landing, no descent or ground return
witness_policy: Horizontal segment from bag XY at flight height
connector_attempts_scope: All examined bag sections; only in-range validated connectors are part of this route
yaw_basis: Explicit world-frame horizontal route tangent at each viewpoint
excluded_intervals: All other disconnected/narrow sections; never connected through exterior space
arrival_policy: Polyline progress with moving lookahead; intermediate waypoints do not require stopping; final landing requires speed below 0.7m/s within 0.15m
validation: Offline dense edge clearance only; full GUI flight required
viewpoint_pause_basis: Continuous waypoint traversal; only the final endpoint requests hold and landing
blocked_loop_policy: Only a nearby same-height return join after 8 seconds stopped without progress; never omit stairs or levels
